fate: Legend says he died in Latium and was honoured as a god.
moments: Escapes Troy with his father Anchises and son Ascanius (Iulus)
Ancestor of Romulus in Roman legend
The Julian family, including Caesar and Augustus, claimed descent from him
name: Aeneas
summary: Son of the Trojan prince Anchises and the goddess Venus. Carried his father out of burning Troy and led the survivors to Italy.
